details: The brush handler fires on both 'brush' and 'end' events and directly mutates attributes on 90 arc paths, 30 nodes, and 30 labels every mousemove frame with no RAF coalescing or debouncing. The pointerenter hover transitions (120ms) start without calling .interrupt() first, so rapid node-to-node hovering causes overlapping mid-flight transitions that can produce jumping opacity/stroke-width values.
